note: Four additional land crops bring the catalog to 100: two warm-season cucurbit fruits, a cool-season pulse, and a warm-climate repeat-cut leafy vegetable. Growth bands and compact crop cycles are gameplay abstractions.

crops.botanical_note: A warm-season Cucumis crop with male and female flowers in many varieties; the game compresses vine growth and fruit maturation into the standard eight-stage cycle.
A warm-season vining crop whose fruit set depends on successful flowering and pollination; the game represents vine spread and fruit development with a compact crop block.
A cool-season legume harvested for its edible seeds and pods. Bee visits can contribute to pollination in the gameplay model, while the crop uses the standard mature-harvest cycle.
A warm-climate leafy vegetable used in several regional cuisines. Repeated cutting represents harvesting young leaves while allowing the plant to regrow.
